card.name: Body-system words after effects on
card.fires_on: Words naming a body system or function right after 'effects on', 'affect' or 'inhibition of', and the middle of 'parasympathetic'. Seen in drug-effect and overdose warnings.

modes.label: Target of an effect
modes.description: Cardiac or heart word right after 'effects on' or 'affect'.
modes.example: all patients should be considered at risk for adverse effects on<< cardiac>> conduction.

modes.description: Pieces of the word parasympathetic in nervous-system lists.

modes.label: Inhibition of
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'inhibition' before a body function.
modes.example: DRUG-INDUCED INHIBITION<< OF>> PERISTALSIS MAY RESULT IN FL

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations that are not 'structure' terms, and away from 'structure' words.
card.plain: It fires where a warning says which body system or function a drug affects, especially the heart or nervous system.
